headings.usage: H1 to H3 must use this font. All uppercase, tight letter spacing (tracking-tight to tracking-tighter), zero rounding. For hero, scale fluidly up to text-[8vw] or text-7xl/8xl if it fits the brutalist style.

body.usage: Clean, highly legible geometric sans for paragraphs, form inputs, and small labels.

colors.rules: Strict adherence to pure solid colors. NO gradients unless it is a harsh brutalist linear split. NO soft shadows. Use sharp 1px or 2px solid borders for separation. Never use purely transparent backgrounds over content; always use a solid or heavily blurred background.

visual_enhancers.shapes: Angular shapes, diagonal cuts. Use CSS clip-path for cards and images (e.g., clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 90%, 90% 100%, 0 100%)).
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp edges (rounded-none). Use thick borders on active states or hero elements to convey confidence.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) across the entire background to kill the 'digital flatness' and make it feel like raw media material.

motion.hero: Masked line-by-line text reveal (staggered upward motion). Background should have slow-moving, large, abstract angular red/black CSS shapes reacting slightly to scroll/mouse (parallax).
motion.interactions: Hover states must be punchy. Background color switches instantly, or border thickness expands. No soft, slow fades. Use sharp spring physics.
motion.stats: Use react-countup for the 4 stats (30+, 720, 1 (Delhi-NCR), 55,000+) triggered when scrolling into view.

layouts.spacing: Generous vertical rhythm. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding.
layouts.grid: Bento or offset grids for 'What We Offer' and 'Why Us'. Do not center everything. Left-align heavy text blocks to build architectural tension.
layouts.hero: Full height (min-h-screen). Massive typography dominating the screen. 'Advertising That Comes Home'. Action-oriented with a sharp red 'Get a Quote' button and an outlined 'View Inventory' button.
layouts.stats_bar: Immediate full-width bar below the fold (or bottom of hero) with stark red borders separating the numbers.
layouts.what_we_offer: 3 cards (Outdoor LED Screens, Indoor Lobby Displays, Entry Gate Unipoles). Instead of literal photos, use Lucide icons (e.g., Monitor, LayoutDashboard, Signpost) at massive sizes (w-16 h-16) paired with stark typography and a clipped-corner layout.
layouts.why_us: Numbered manifesto format (01, 02, 03) taking up large column spans. Extreme contrast between the huge number and the text.
layouts.how_it_works: Horizontal flow. 3 steps connected by a red line. Step 1: Strategy, Step 2: Deployment, Step 3: Analytics.
layouts.social_proof: Instead of images, use a text-based brutalist grid of generic brand categories or typography-based brand names (e.g., 'REAL ESTATE', 'AUTO', 'FMCG') scaling across a marquee.
layouts.contact: Lead capture form. Strict rectangular fields (rounded-none), thick bottom borders, stark layout.

components.nav: Sticky at top. Solid black or heavy backdrop-blur. Contains Angular DM Logo, Services, Why Us, How It Works, Contact, Get a Quote button. Smooth anchor scrolling to sections.
components.button: Sharp rectangles. Primary: bg-[#E31E24] text-white hover:bg-[#C81A1F]. Secondary: border-2 border-white text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black. Include an arrow icon that translates right on hover.
components.form: Shadcn based but completely stripped of Vercel aesthetic. No rounded corners. border-b only or stark box borders. bg-transparent for inputs.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an 'Editorial Ribbon'. Text: 'ADVERTISING THAT COMES HOME • DELIVERING HIGH-IMPACT DOOH • DELHI-NCR •'. Large, outlined text (text-transparent stroke-white) acting as a section divider.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against black/red meets WCAG AA. Red (#E31E24) on Black (#050505) might require white text on top of the red for legibility. White text on black is perfectly accessible.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Size them large to match the brutalist aesthetic (stroke-width 1.5 or 2).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add framer-motion lucide-react react-fast-marquee react-countup clsx tailwind-merge @radix-ui/react-slot lenis
Import Bebas Neue and Manrope fonts into index.css via Google Fonts.
Override default tailwind config to add pure 'brand-red': '#E31E24', 'brand-black': '#050505'.
NEVER use border-radius for main elements (cards, buttons, inputs). Enforce 'rounded-none'.
Implement the clipped corner effect on cards using inline style or Tailwind arbitrary class: clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 20px), calc(100% - 20px) 100%, 0 100%).
Build the Hero section without any photos. Use heavy CSS styling, massive Bebas Neue text, and framer-motion to create an energetic, aggressive brand presence.
Implement a smooth scroll wrapper using Lenis.
Ensure the app is fully responsive, mobile-first. Typography must scale fluidly.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements as per universal guidelines.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Be aggressive with the brutalist style.
Implement micro-animations on all interactive elements (hover states, focus).
Do not apply 'transition: all'. Target specific properties.
No emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Do not center-align body text globally.
Make sure form inputs have explicit hover/focus states.
Ensure contrast ratios are strictly adhered to.
